<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>ShopEase Support SLM</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      color-scheme: light;
      --bg: #f4f7fb;
      --panel: #ffffff;
      --ink: #172033;
      --muted: #61708a;
      --line: #dbe3ef;
      --brand: #1f5eff;
      --brand-dark: #1748c7;
      --user: #e8f0ff;
      --assistant: #f7f9fc;
      --error: #a92323;
      --error-bg: #fff0f0;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #eef4ff 0%, var(--bg) 55%, #f8fbff 100%);
      color: var(--ink);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 20px;
    }
    .shell {
      width: min(860px, 100%);
      height: min(760px, calc(100vh - 40px));
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
      background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(29, 47, 88, 0.12);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    header {
      padding: 18px 22px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.08rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    .subtitle { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.82rem; }
    button {
      font: inherit;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 10px;
      transition: background 120ms ease, opacity 120ms ease;
    }
    #clear-button {
      padding: 9px 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: #eef2f8;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    #clear-button:hover { background: #e2e8f2; }
    #messages {
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 22px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }
    .message {
      max-width: 82%;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    .message.user {
      align-self: flex-end;
      background: var(--user);
      border-color: #d4e2ff;
    }
    .message.assistant {
      align-self: flex-start;
      background: var(--assistant);
      border-color: var(--line);
    }
    .meta {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 7px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
    }
    .message.error {
      align-self: stretch;
      max-width: 100%;
      color: var(--error);
      background: var(--error-bg);
      border-color: #ffc9c9;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
    .loading {
      align-self: flex-start;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      padding: 2px 4px;
    }
    .loading::after {
      content: "";
      display: inline-block;
      width: 1.2em;
      text-align: left;
      animation: dots 1.2s steps(4, end) infinite;
    }
    @keyframes dots {
      0% { content: ""; }
      25% { content: "."; }
      50% { content: ".."; }
      75% { content: "..."; }
      100% { content: ""; }
    }
    form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: #fbfcff;
    }
    textarea {
      flex: 1;
      resize: none;
      min-height: 48px;
      max-height: 150px;
      padding: 12px 13px;
      font: inherit;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 12px;
      outline: none;
    }
    textarea:focus {
      border-color: var(--brand);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31, 94, 255, 0.12);
    }
    #send-button {
      min-width: 88px;
      padding: 0 18px;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: var(--brand);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    #send-button:hover { background: var(--brand-dark); }
